scope: Close only the four retired PT02 negative-control obligations. Do not rerun the passed full R5 suite or modify any original assertion or production code.

test_derivation.method: Retain exact imports and helper bytes, rename only the standalone class, preserve the sourceCopy/serialized loop and exact original PT02 body. Omit the unrelated PT01/PT03-PT06 registrations from the new companion only. The original complete test file remains unchanged.

negative_prediction.basis: The original qualified-baseline PT02 reports exposed stack sizes 2 for target-copy and 1 for source-copy; the former includes the resolving instant. The legacy entry-choice resumer stacks the first token's watcher trigger before the next batch choice. The typed assertion should now isolate one premature trigger in all four variants. This is a prospective prediction, not an observed result.

positive_prediction.requirements: Original PT02 body verifies zero premature triggers/tokens, exact resolving-spell identity, final two triggers and final life 22, including serialized variants.

baseline_restore.proof: Require all src/main differences from the qualified baseline to equal the nine restored production paths. Require exact baseline bytes/absences before negative tests. Restore exact candidate bytes and clean tracked tree before positives.

execution: One guarded source-bound workflow, exact four-case class on qualified baseline, then same class on the unchanged R5 production source. Preserve original XML, logs, exit codes and all failures. A compiler error, different first frame, wrong failure message or missing case does not close the control gate.
separation: These four paired controls are separate from R5's four EP provenance regression controls, the historical 70-case ledger and competitive gameplay. Historical unchanged controls require their own eligibility audit; do not invent a new 70-case single run.
